an5.11:1.1: pubbāhaṃ bhikkhave ananussutesu dhammesu abhiññāvosāna- pāramippatto paṭijānāmi
an5.11:1.2: pañcimāni bhikkhave tathāgatassa tathāgatabalāni yehi balehi samannāgato tathāgato āsabhaṇṭhānaṃ paṭijānāti parisāsu sīhanādaṃ nadati brahmacakkaṃ pavatteti
an5.11:1.5: imāni kho bhikkhave pañca tathāgatassa tathāgatabalāni yehi balehi samannāgato tathāgato āsabhaṇṭhānaṃ paṭijānāti parisāsu sīhanādaṃ nadati brahmacakkaṃ pavattetīti.
